The first tagged release. Until now the only way to get Sanctumd was the rolling dev build,
whatever master happened to be that hour. This one has a tag behind it and a signed APK.

## Music is music

- An album opens its own screen: cover, artist and year, running time, and a numbered track
  list. A tap plays from there, a long press opens the details.
- Play and shuffle sit on the album itself, and Now Playing has the controls a player is
  expected to have: shuffle, repeat all, repeat one.
- Playback outlives the screen that started it, and the lock screen, Bluetooth headsets and car
  head units have their controls back.
- The Jellyfin tile counts songs, which it had been passing over.

## Looking a title up before adding it

- Searching Radarr, Sonarr or Lidarr shows posters, and a hit opens an info screen: rating,
  runtime, genres, the plot, and whether the service already holds the title. Adding is one
  button there rather than the only thing the list can do.
- Seerr's search does the same, through the detail sheet it already had.
- Both live behind a menu entry that now says **Search**. It was findable only if you already
  knew it was there.

## One look across the app

- Every action icon comes from a single registry, named for what it means. The same action used
  to wear two different symbols two screens apart, because some buttons drew an icon and others
  carried the character in their label.
- Warning and error colours are theme tokens now, not 35 hand-written values.
- No emoji anywhere: where a symbol is needed it is a vector in the theme colour, and where none
  is needed there is plain text.

## Security

The repository went through a full security audit and every real finding was fixed. Credentials
no longer travel in URLs, TLS verification cannot silently switch itself off, download paths are
assembled rather than borrowed from the server, and the widget and notification paths were
tightened. That is why the number jumps from 1.58 to 2.0 instead of creeping.

The app lock also promises only what it keeps: it gates the screen, not the stored data, because
push, widgets and downloads have to work while the phone is in your pocket. The switch, the hint
under it and SECURITY.md all say so now.

`CHANGELOG.md` in the repository carries the detailed account.

## Installing

Download `sanctumd-v2.0.0.apk` below. Android will ask you to allow installs from this source.
Updating over an earlier build keeps your configuration.
